laws.rule: Visiting the Kotor city walls and St John (Sveti Ivan) fortress costs €15 (about A$23.84 at the RBA rate of 30 October 2026) per person, charged 1 March to 30 November at the Parilo and Škaljarska pjaca entrances (Gurdić if needed). Hours: 8am to 6pm (1 March to 30 April), 7am to 8pm (1 May to 30 September), 8am to 5pm (1 October to 30 November). Exempt: children up to 12, Montenegrin residents, people with severe sensory or physical disabilities, school groups and some others, with proof. Not paying is fined €20 (about A$31.78 at the RBA rate of 30 October 2026) to €1000 (about A$1,589 at the RBA rate of 30 October 2026).
